title: Steps 步骤条
description: 展示流程的各个阶段，并允许用户在阶段之间切换。

events.name: minerva-change
events.description: The user navigated to a step (`detail: { value }`); cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the current step

wc:minerva-steps.description: The stages of a workflow as an ordered list (`<Steps>` of React). Earlier steps are marked complete and the current one with `aria-current="step"`. By default the steps are a read-only progress indicator (no buttons, `aria-current` on the `<li>`); with `navigable` each step is a native button, and choosing one sets `value` and fires `minerva-change` (validation and workflow transitions belong to the caller: cancel the event to keep the current step).

properties.name: value
properties.description: Value of the current step ("" matches no step)

properties.name: navigable
properties.description: Renders each step as a button the user can navigate with (default: read-only)

events.name: minerva-change
events.description: The user navigated to a step (`detail: { value }`); cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the current step

parts.name: item
parts.description: A step `<li>` (the current step has aria-current=step)

parts.name: button
parts.description: The `<button>` of a step (navigable) or its static wrapper (read-only)

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The numbered indicator of a step

basic.title: 基础用法
basic.description: 初始选中 Review，选择 Draft 可返回；Publish 处于禁用状态。

read-only.title: 只读进度
read-only.description: 不传 onChange 时，步骤条为只读的进度指示：一个不含按钮的有序列表，当前项带有 aria-current="step"。

styling.title: 样式
styling.description: 已完成步骤以实心圆点加对勾显示，当前步骤带柔和光环，连接线随步骤完成而着色。--steps-accent-color 改变颜色，--steps-connector-min-width / --steps-connector-color 调整连接线。

StepsProps.value: 当前步骤的值（受控，配合 onChange）
StepsProps.defaultValue: 初始当前步骤的值（非受控）
StepsProps.onChange: 用户切换到某步骤时以其值调用。只报告导航，校验与流程流转由调用方负责
StepsProps.readOnly: 以只读进度指示渲染：普通列表项、不含按钮，当前项标记 aria-current="step"

StepsItem.value: 步骤的唯一值，与 Steps 的 value 匹配
StepsItem.label: 步骤的可见文字
StepsItem.disabled: 禁止切换到该步骤（例如尚未到达的终态）

cssVars.--steps-gap: 步骤之间的间距（行距与列距）
cssVars.--steps-accent-color: 当前 / 已完成指示器的颜色（默认 --primary-color）
cssVars.--steps-current-background: 当前步骤指示器的背景
cssVars.--steps-connector-color: 连接未完成步骤的线条颜色（默认为 --border-color）
cssVars.--steps-connector-complete-color: 已完成步骤之后的线条颜色（默认为强调色）
cssVars.--steps-connector-min-width: 连接两个步骤的线条最小长度
